posts.text:
Google just made studying feel like cheating.
Upload any PDF.
Google AI Pro converts it into a podcast.

Not a robotic text-to-speech reading.
An actual two-host conversation breaking down your document like a real episode.

I uploaded a 40 page research paper.
Got a 12 minute podcast back.
Two voices. Back and forth. Explaining concepts. Asking questions. Making it stick.

This changes everything for how I consume information.
Long contracts. Research papers. Business reports. Technical docs.

Anything you've been putting off reading because it's too dense
Now you can listen to it on a walk.

We are living in a time where the gap between "I should read this" and "I actually understand this" just got a lot smaller.

The people who figure out how to use these tools well aren't going to be smarter.
They're just going to be faster.

Are you sleeping on Google AI Pro right now?

Head over and give it a listen yourself 👇
https://lnkd.in/dWWfBHWK

Sendio just dropped something interesting.

264 million people. One search.
Filter by job title, seniority, department, location, industry, headcount growth, funding, revenue, technologies used all in one place.

We've been with Sendio for a month at TA Solutions.
And this new Find Leads feature just changed how we think about outreach entirely.

No more jumping between 4 tools to build a list.
No more guessing who the right person is.
Just clean, targeted leads ready to contact.

We recently came across Esfera as well.
And honestly this is exactly the kind of network we'd love to be part of.

The way they're connecting tools, teams and opportunities is something that aligns with how we think about building at TA Solutions.

We're a development agency.
We don't just build software we make it work inside your actual business.
Custom development. Workflow automation. Platform integration.
Everything connected. Nothing sitting idle.

Still exploring everything Sendio's new update brings to the table.
But early signs are exactly what we needed.

If you want to understand how this platform works or want to get onboarded 
DM me. I'll walk you through it personally.

P.S: To the Sendio and Esfera teams would love to connect and explore what we can build together. 🤝 Ricardo T. Paolo Angeloni Giovana Tess

Lately I've been thinking about both worlds. The one I'm building and the one I'm answering to.

I was in church last Sunday.

The pastor read something that stopped me mid-thought.

"Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters." — Colossians 3:23

I've heard that verse before.
But this time it hit different.

Because I've been in rooms where people do the bare minimum. Clock in. Clock out. Do enough to not get fired.
And I've been in rooms where one person makes everyone around them better just by how seriously they take their work.

The difference was never talent.
It was who they thought they were working for.

When you work for approval, you stop when nobody's watching.
When you work for something bigger than a paycheck, you raise your standard even when no one's in the room.

The highest performers I've ever met don't work hard because their manager is watching.
They work hard because lowering their standard feels like a personal betrayal.

That's not hustle culture.
That's integrity.

The church didn't teach me a business lesson last Sunday.
It reminded me that how you do anything is how you do everything.

What's one standard you hold yourself to even when nobody's watching?

📍𝐒𝐭. 𝐏𝐚𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐤'𝐬 𝐂𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐥
